Album - Class in com.example.model
The class Album contains the attributes, constructor, methods, and getters necessary for the creation, modification, and manipulation of an album entry with:
the inherited methods of: assigning a status (and modifying it), assigning a rating, and assigning a review; and
the unique method of: updating the album entry's current track progress, and returning its information via String
